claims.locus: astro.com in_lgbyjove2_e.htm — Psychology of Jupiter (authorized extract)
claims.original_claim: Arrogance and inflation often hide wounds we do not want to face; we enlist Jupiter — our sense of connection with a greater purpose — as a defence.
claims.normalized_claim: Jupiter may be enlisted as a defence: greater-purpose connection hiding unfaced wounds.

claims.author: Liz Greene
claims.edition: By Jove!, Wessex Astrologer 2025 ISBN 9781916625242; astro.com extract
claims.locus: astro.com in_lgbyjove2_e.htm — Psychology of Jupiter (authorized extract)
claims.original_claim: If we identify with the archetypal principle Jupiter symbolises, consciousness can no longer mediate and hubris invokes nemesis. Humility and laughter, not control, are the creative tools.
claims.normalized_claim: Identifying with Jupiter (not mediating) yields hubris/nemesis; humility and laughter, not control.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Jupiter, Organizer of Functions
claims.original_claim: Jupiter's meaning is organic function: unfoldment, development, and growth. Function complements Saturn's structure — the latter static, the former dynamic and unfolding.
claims.normalized_claim: Jupiter = organizer of organic function (dynamic unfoldment); Saturn = structure. Complements; not intelligible alone.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Jupiter, Organizer of Functions
claims.original_claim: Purpose determines form, and form determines function. Purpose is the Heart of the Sun; form is Saturn; function is Jupiter. To say function determines form misuses the term.
claims.normalized_claim: Solar purpose → Saturn form → Jupiter function. Function does not determine form.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Jupiter, Organizer of Functions
claims.original_claim: Jupiter's first role operates only within Saturn's magic circle. He organizes the substance within the pale — the faithful — keeping it coherent and distinct from the without.
claims.normalized_claim: Jupiter first organizes the within of Saturn's boundary; no organism exists without that wall.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Jupiter, Organizer of Functions
claims.original_claim: Inside Saturn's frame Jupiter differentiates chaotic materials, giving each unit its most congenial task. As builder of a hierarchy of functions he is Hierarch, organizer, and overseer.
claims.normalized_claim: Jupiter = Hierarch: assigns differentiated tasks into a hierarchy of functions inside Saturn's frame.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Jupiter, Organizer of Functions
claims.original_claim: The sense of unity of the organic whole is religion: that which binds cells back to the whole. Jupiter is master of religion as faith in a beneficent All-Father, distinct from Saturnian ritual law.
claims.normalized_claim: Jupiter = master of religion as binding-back to organic unity (faith), not Saturn's ritual law.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Jupiter, Organizer of Functions
claims.original_claim: The Jupiter-Saturn Twins cannot be separated. Saturn's inertia always tries to pull Jupiterian flights toward the beyond and vaster wholeness back to old forms and techniques.
claims.normalized_claim: Jupiter-Saturn Twins are inseparable; Saturn's inertia pulls Jupiterian flights back to old forms.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Jupiter, Organizer of Functions
claims.original_claim: Where Saturn's walls of consciousness hold, Jupiter opens the gates. He is then the beneficent power of expansion — but only if balanced by the steady restraint of Saturn's Law.
claims.normalized_claim: Jupiter's expansion is beneficent only when balanced by Saturn's restraining Law; collapsed walls yield the amorphous.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Jupiter, Organizer of Functions
claims.original_claim: Against Saturn's crystallizing inertia Jupiter becomes Soul: compensation through feeling, love, and thirst for universal truths unbounded by creed. He is the pathway of liberation, the guru as a lens.
claims.normalized_claim: Jupiter as Soul/compensator and guru-lens: pathway of liberation from Saturn's crystallizing logic.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Jupiter, Organizer of Functions
claims.original_claim: Jupiter always operates in relation to Saturn: with him inside the boundary, or against him as compensation. Even then his power is conditioned by Saturn. Neither reaches the Heart of the Sun.
claims.normalized_claim: Jupiter always relative to Saturn (with or compensating); neither reaches the Heart of the Sun.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Jupiter, Organizer of Functions
claims.original_claim: As Greater Fortune Jupiter vitalizes the quest for Grail or gold. Too often he makes man reach greedily beyond capacity for assimilation, over-eating physical or psychical food toward a false sphere of wholeness.
claims.normalized_claim: Greater Fortune: greedy reach beyond assimilation; over-intake as a false image of wholeness.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Jupiter, Organizer of Functions
claims.original_claim: Jupiter makes the little self yearn to participate as a cell in a greater Self. Through over-confidence he may sacrifice individual integrity to a God who is a mirage. Even compassion can be escape from a sour Saturn.
claims.normalized_claim: Yearning for the greater Whole can sacrifice individual integrity to a mirage-God, or escape Saturn via compassion.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Jupiter, Organizer of Functions
claims.original_claim: Inward form (the mold) is Saturnian; outward form — substance ready to function and reveal — is Jupiterian. Jupiter is the point of emanation of Soul, filling Saturn's limitations until the mold is no longer needed.
claims.normalized_claim: Jupiter = outward formed substance / Soul-emanation filling Saturn's inward mold until the mold can dissolve.
